about_short_description.short_description: Elucd enables cities to understand the realtime pulse of their residents priorities.

product.name: Zencity for Public Safety
product.description: A platform for measuring resident trust and public perception of safety, supporting community-aligned policing through surveys and data analysis.

product.name: Trust and Safety Surveys
product.description: Surveys designed to gather feedback on residents' trust and sense of safety, utilizing digital distribution for broad community engagement.

product.name: Smart Satisfaction Surveys
product.description: Surveys aimed at understanding public satisfaction with local safety measures, featuring anonymous participation and live feedback analysis.

product.name: Representative Feedback
product.description: Feedback collection cross-referenced with U.S. Census data to ensure community-wide representation in survey responses.

product.name: Anonymous Questionnaire
product.description: A survey tool that guarantees participant anonymity to encourage honest and open feedback on public safety issues.

product.name: Live Scores
product.description: Real-time trust and safety scores provided to city officials for informed strategic planning and decision-making.
